name: postgres
description: PostgreSQL database integration for querying and schema inspection

steps: 1. Review and install an approved PostgreSQL MCP server
2. Replace the command with its local executable
3. Set DATABASE_URL to a least-privilege connection string
4. Add the config to your Claude settings file
securityNotes: Use a read-only database user for safety
Consider using a connection string without write permissions
Never use production credentials for development

notes: For safety, consider creating a read-only database user for Claude to use.
